items.title: Theorem 5.1: gluing T-structured infinity-topoi along closed immersions
items.statement_scope: Let T be a pregeometry. Suppose given morphisms (X,OX)←(K,OK)→(Y,OY) in Top(T) inducing closed immersions of ∞-topoi X←K→Y. Let Z be the pushout X∐_K Y in Top, with the resulting commutative diagram of geometric morphisms. Let OZ:T→Z be OZ(X)=f*OX(X)×_{h*OK(X)}g*OY(X). Then OZ is a T-structure on Z, and the diagram (K,OK)→(X,OX), (K,OK)→(Y,OY), (X,OX)→(Z,OZ), (Y,OY)→(Z,OZ) is a pushout square in Top(T); in particular the natural transformations g*OZ→OY and f*OZ→OX are local. Whole theorem, including all displayed maps and locality conclusion, is retained.
items.difficulty_reason: Rule author-work-bearing-core-v1-20261114: the unit is a substantial research-bearing gluing construction, defining OZ as a fiber product of structure sheaves over the pushout of ∞-topoi, proving it is a T-structure and that the square is a pushout in Top(T), with a full cofinality and closed-subtopos argument (statement pages 25-26; proof pages 29-30). This is far beyond routine qualifying-exam work.

difficulty_evidence.bearing_core: Construction of the T-structure OZ on the pushout of T-structured ∞-topoi along closed immersions and proof that the resulting square is a pushout in Top(T).
